title: Azure CLI sign-in state
whyItMatters: Cached Azure sign-in tokens and subscription settings let someone use the account's cloud access from this machine.
source: Azure CLI configuration and cached credentials in ~/.azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/azure-cli-configuration
notes: Older CLI versions use accessTokens.json; newer ones use an MSAL token cache. Both sit in this folder.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Azure CLI, then remove this device's cached sign-in from your Microsoft account security page.
steps: Sign out of the Azure command line tools you used on this PC.
Delete the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Removes the cached Azure sign-in and subscription settings from this PC. Access granted to the account itself is unchanged.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Learn, Sign in with Azure CLI: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/authenticate-azure-cli
